reviews.text:
I'd been struggling to find the right salon for a long time, but a cute little girl I met on a walk recommended this one, and I finally went!
My dog, Mignon, is a Bichon Frise, and the grooming was absolutely fantastic; I'm so happy with the result!
I've finally found a wonderful salon that I want to keep going back to!

Despite my dog's coarse coat, they always give him a beautiful finish that lasts a long time, keeping him looking adorable. Even after half a month, when I shampoo him at home and his fur has grown out, he still looks incredibly cute. I even bought the same shampoo they use, after asking them what they use. The scent and fluffiness are worlds apart from commercially available shampoos.

I've seen a few negative reviews about the staff, but I think mutual trust is important, so if you communicate any concerns or questions beforehand, I'm sure you'll both have a pleasant experience.

Above all, I hope they prioritize your dog's well-being!

This was my second visit.
I requested a haircut for my Toy Poodle.
Above all, the staff's service was wonderful; they always greeted my dog ​​with a smile and kindness, which gave me a real sense of reassurance. The consultation was very thorough, and they listened carefully to my detailed requests. During the grooming, I could tell they were proceeding at my dog's pace, speaking to him gently, and I felt completely at ease leaving him in their care. I would like to continue coming here. Thank you!

Since my first visit, this salon has become one of my favorites.

The salon is clean, and the staff are all bright, friendly, and welcoming, making it a very comfortable place to be.

Their skills are superb; the haircuts are always beautiful and last a long time.

They carefully accommodate even my smallest requests, and they've created a look that's even cuter than I imagined.

People around me have been complimenting me on how cute I look. I'll definitely be coming back regularly!

My dog ​​always comes back with a fluffy coat! I love the cute photos they take after the grooming is finished♪ Booking via LINE was also convenient. Most importantly, my dog ​​loves the staff member and looks forward to each visit, which I really appreciate.

I was completely satisfied with everything: the finished result, the customer service, and the atmosphere of the salon! The cut was exactly as I wanted, and I was so impressed with how fluffy my dog's fur became. They were very gentle with my dog, and I felt completely at ease leaving him in their care. Thank you as always. I will definitely be coming back!

Anyway, I'm writing this because it was so unpleasant.
I used the service for the first time the other day, and to begin with, the staff's attitude was rude. When I asked about the price and pick-up time, they didn't even look me in the eye and just gave me a brusque response. They also gave me an irresponsible response, telling me to check the price on their website.
When I actually went to pay, I was stunned to be presented with a price that was about 1.5 times the price listed on the website, but I figured there was no point in saying anything, so I just paid the fee and went home...
I realized that this was definitely not a trustworthy place to leave my beloved dog.

We've been using your services for many years.
My dog ​​is a senior and quite fussy, but I'm always so grateful for the careful grooming you do.
You also point out things I wouldn't notice at home when I pick him up, and I feel at ease continuing to bring him here because safety is your top priority.
The events you hold for dogs, such as chiropractic treatments, massages, and teeth-brushing lessons, are also very appealing.
This time, I took advantage of the chiropractic treatment event.
Thank you very much.
Next time, I'll be using your grooming services.
Thank you in advance! ☺︎🌷.*
The customer service and technical skills were absolutely terrible. My child's ears became irritated and we had to take them to the vet.

This is Kosuke, a Toy Poodle, who has been coming to DoggieDo since around this spring, thanks to a friend's recommendation. 🐶
At first, I didn't have a specific cut or design in mind, so I was going to a local salon, but after starting to go to DoggieDo, I loved the fluffy and adorable finish! ♡
Kosuke is always doted on by the staff and seems to have a great time, which makes me happy too. ☺️
Thank you for your continued support! 🙇🏻‍♀️

I asked for a Chihuahua shampoo and a partial cut!
It was just a shampoo, but I was surprised at how different the result was from other salons!
I wonder if they use a different shampoo? There seem to be a lot of options, so I'd like to try something different next time!
I look forward to seeing you again!

Since the store is moving from Shirokanedai to Hiroo, I decided to use the Azabu store for the first time in a while!
My dog ​​seemed very happy when he arrived, as he seemed to remember the staff from the Shirokanedai store.
The grooming was so adorable, and the whole family is very happy.
He's cute wherever he goes! He's always been told he's fluffy, and I know I'm a doting parent, but he really is adorable, lol.

Next time, I'll be using the Hiroo store!
Thank you for your continued support.

↓This post was from two years ago.

I used Doggie-Do for my old miniature dachshund.
This was my first time using Doggie-Do, and they were so kind and thorough in shampooing and grooming, tailored to my dog's condition and health. I felt at ease leaving him there.
The staff were also very helpful and willing to give me any questions I might have.
Thank you for your continued support!

It's the worst.
I took him to the vet at 11am with round eyes, but when I went to pick him up at 5:30pm, his eyes looked so painful I wonder if he got shampoo in them or if he'd been scratched.

We've been using this salon for about five years now, since we adopted our Toy Poodle.

No matter which groomer we get, they always share information with each other and do a great job, so we can leave our dog with them with peace of mind.

The groomers are always so gentle with dogs; our dog even falls asleep during grooming!

I'm impressed by how they notice even the slightest changes in our dog's physical condition.

This is a salon we hope to continue using for many years to come.
My dog ​​seemed happy and enjoyed herself at this salon. The staff were all very kind, and I'm very satisfied with the results.
